subject: Interview slot ownership + eval priors for SWE-Backend (Sr)
messages:
From: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai>
Cc: Sara Patel <sara@talentworks.io>
Date: Mon, 12 Jul 2027 09:04:00 -0700
Subject: Interview slot ownership + eval priors for SWE-Backend (Sr)

Team —

Quick operational note ahead of Alex Zhou's loop tomorrow. Goal is to make the day lower-friction for the candidate and produce debrief-ready signals that align to the role scope. I attached the JD + a short eval primer. Please review the bullets below and confirm who will own each slot by EOD today.

Summary:
- Candidate: Alex Zhou (cand-4731) — resume attached.
- Role: SWE, Backend (Senior) — focus areas: distributed systems, latency-sensitive design, API/consistency tradeoffs.
- Interview loop: 4 x 60m interviews (system design, backend coding + optimization, production reliability, leadership/ownership).

Slot ownership proposition (please reply with accepts/changes):
1) 10:00 — System design (owner: Markus) — assess component design, scaling strategy, tradeoffs for KV cache + model serving endpoints. Look for conversation about tail latency and graceful degradation.
2) 11:15 — Backend coding / optimization (owner: Marissa) — evaluate algorithmic reasoning, time/space tradeoffs, ability to optimize for throughput.
3) 13:30 — Production reliability & observability (owner: Laura) — incident triage mindset, monitoring, rollbacks, and SLO tradeoffs.
4) 15:00 — Leadership / ownership / cross-team collaboration (owner: Vanessa) — candidate's approach to roadmaps, prioritization, and mentoring.

Evaluation priors (applies to all interviewers):
- Focus on 3-4 signal-sized questions per interview (don’t overload).
- Avoid surface-level hypotheticals; ask for concrete past examples or design sketches.
- Capture explicit artifacts in your notes: biggest tradeoff, SLO target you’d choose, one follow-up you’d execute after hire.
- If the candidate is straddling levels, note both evidence for Sr and missing stretch areas.

Attachments: SWE-Backend-Sr-JD.pdf, eval-primer-SWE-Backend-Sr.md, candidate-resume-AlexZhou.pdf

Thanks — please hit reply-all with confirmations.

— Mina
Mina Haddad
Hiring Manager, Inference Product
Redwood Inference

From: Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.ai>

Date: Mon, 12 Jul 2027 10:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Interview slot ownership + eval priors for SWE-Backend (Sr)

Mina — taking the system design slot (10:00). I’ll bring a simple prompt about KV cache sharding and cold-start behavior; will probe for reasoning on caching strategies vs. routing.

Notes I’ll capture in debrief: 1) high-level architecture, 2) reasoning about tail latency and mitigation, 3) tradeoffs in consistency vs. availability.

I skimmed the primer — suggest we add a quick line to the primer that we want the interviewer to call out when they believe the candidate is clearly Sr vs. when they think "near-Sr". I can add that and send a 1-paragraph update.

— Markus

Principal Engineer, Serving Runtime

To: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.ai>, Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 12 Jul 2027 11:30:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Interview slot ownership + eval priors for SWE-Backend (Sr)

Confirmed — taking 11:15 coding slot. Quick note on prompts: I’ll do a two-stage exercise (write a working sketch then optimize hot path). I’ll timebox the first 25m for implementation and use the remaining time for performance discussion.

Also: candidate's resume shows a recent project shipping a custom RPC stack. If they mention that, I’ll dig into serialization choices and batching effects on latency.

Attached: small sample of microbench scaffolding I use (just a stub) — will share link in debrief.

— Marissa
Senior Software Engineer

From: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.ai>

Date: Tue, 13 Jul 2027 15:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Interview slot ownership + eval priors for SWE-Backend (Sr)

Thanks for the quick confirms — and thanks Markus for offering to tweak the primer. Two small follow-ups before we close the loop:

1) Debrief cadence: After the last interview, let’s do a 20-minute synchronous debrief (15:50 in the calendar) to capture immediate impressions. If anyone needs to step away, please leave notes in the shared doc and mark the candidate as "Strong / Okay / Weak" per rubric.

2) On leveling: if you're unsure between Sr and Staff signals, explicitly call out which 1-2 behaviors you’d expect to see at Staff (e.g., cross-team strategy, long-term ownership on infra migrations, large-scale API contract design). That will help PMR and Hiring with calibration.

3) Attachments & links below — use the calendar link to jump to the loop and the Drive folder for the debrief doc.

Attachments: candidate-resume-AlexZhou.pdf
Links: https://calendar.google.com/event?eid=abc123-interview-cand4731, https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1aBcDefInterviewPack

See you tomorrow.
